messages:
emma: Heads-up — opened docs PR #842 adding an SDK snippet for streaming and a small migration note. Need a reviewer and a green preview before merge.
raj: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — will check in ~30m. Any flaky CI details?
sophie: I can review after stand. Quick question: is this behind a note about model pinning?
emma: yes added a short line about pinning model versions for Dedicated/Private. The preview sometimes 503s on Netlify though. netlify-bot posted a preview URL earlier.
netlify-bot: Deploy started for branch docs/pr-842 — preview will be at https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app once ready
mike: FYI saw a 503 yesterday caused by one large asset upload. Local check: `mkdocs build --strict` exposes link problems faster.
emma: added local preview instructions to the PR description: `pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000`
raj: small nit: the JS snippet uses `client.generate(...)` — can we switch to `client.stream(...)` example to match other guides?
emma: good call, updated snippet and pushed. Also included a short example for canary rollout config.
sophie: lgtm once tests pass. Also added one line about embedding/insights differences for embeddings API.
emma: Netlify rebuild triggered: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app (build in queue)
ci-bot: check/linkcheck — queued
ci-bot: check/format — passed
ci-bot: check/linkcheck — passed
ci-bot: netlify-preview — succeeded (preview URL: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app)
mike: OK looks green. I'll merge in the 16:00 UTC merge slot so it doesn't collide with overnight runs.
emma: thanks — I'll monitor the docs site after merge and update release notes if anything odd.
sophie: added reviewers to the docs OWNERS file to speed approvals for future small PRs :thumbsup: 
raj: can we add a one-line test that ensures the fenced code block doesn't get wrapped incorrectly? avoids markdown breakages on CI.
emma: added `tests/snippets/test_js_snippet.md` with a tiny fenced-block assertion. Pushed.
netlify-bot: Cache invalidation: triggered for /assets/main.js after deploy
mike: merging now. :rocket:
emma: cheers — will ping if any regressions show up.
